java_authorship.owner_statement: The Java implementation was rewritten with Aero Islands as inspiration/reference. Similarity and historical attribution comments do not alone prove copied expression or legal derivation.
java_authorship.comparison_scope: Eight original class fingerprints map to seven current files; algorithmic correspondences include pillar taper, selected draw order and mineshaft assembly. This is a behavior/source comparison, not an authorship determination for the complete generator.
java_authorship.license_decision: Retain GPL-3.0-or-later for the complete owned mod in 0.1.0; 160 exact and 37 changed Aero JSON remain incorporated, plus one separately attributed Minecraft resource.
